mods.name: Sound / Recording
mods.author: TEO-F
mods.summary: Choose16-bit or24-bit stereo WAV recording at44.1 kHz.
mods.description: Dedicated settings page inside Community Mods. Default16-bit; the selected depth applies to the next recording. Two short16/24-bit recordings verified on one XDJ-AZ. Long recordings, automatic splits and error recovery remain unverified. Exact supported firmware only. No live recording-format readback.
